scope: Theorem 1.1 of the manuscript “Projective-space bases of Lagrangian fibrations” (preprints/Projective-Space-Bases-of-Lagrangian-Fibrations-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5fdf543649f1469a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let n ≥ 1, and let X be a compact irreducible holomorphic symplectic Kähler manifold of dimension 2n, with symplectic form σ. Suppose that f : X −→ B is a projective surjective holomorphic morphism with connected fibers, where B is a normal projective variety of dimension n. Assume that every irreducible component of every fiber has dimension n and that the restriction of σ to its smooth locus is zero. Then B is isomorphic to Pn C.
